Name: (Recolor) Ridgeside Village - Deon's Earthy toned down colors
Author: DeonDF
Description:
[b]What does it do:[/b]

- Provides seasonal recolors to all RSV buildings and most of indoor furniture.
- Recolors the world map according to season.

The colors are picked to suit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255?tab=posts]DaisyNiko's Earthy recolor[/url].
Example images can be found in the mod pictures.

[b]Installation:[/b]
- Install RidgeSide Village mod.
- Manually drop the archive contents into /mods/ folder, allowing to overwrite the files.

[b]Credits:[/b]
A bunch of farm buildings are adapted from the amazing mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9219]Billy0815's custom seasonal buildings[/url]﻿ (used with permission).
